facts.claim: The 2026 municipal PDF lists Paseo de las Ánimas on 30 October, activities 18:00–23:00 in San Juan, La Ermita and San Sebastián; Catrinas parade on 31 October at 20:00; altar activities in Plaza Grande on 1 and 2 November at 10:00.
